title: Elixir of Half-Orcish Fury
summary: Until Long Rest, the first time you would be Downed, remain at 1 HP instead.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Until Long Rest, the first time you would be Downed, remain at 1 HP instead.
fields.Acquisition: Trade half-orc blood to Araj Oblodra in Moonrise Towers or the Lower City.
fields.Stacking: Araj’s elixirs stack with ordinary elixirs and other Araj elixirs.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
